evals.name: cod-prompt-rewrite
evals.prompt: I built a COD order confirmation agent on Bolna for our online store (Sarvam Bulbul v4 Flash voice, Hindi). Customers say it sounds robotic and reads out weird stuff like hashes and links. The agent export is at {INPUTS}/cod-confirmation/agent.json. We pass customer_name, order_id, items, order_amount and address on each call. Can you fix the system prompt and welcome message?
evals.expected_output: Rewritten system prompt and welcome message: Devanagari Hindi with English words in Latin script, short welcome with AI disclosure and one question, no links/emails/order IDs read aloud, speaking and situation rules, flags delivery_date as not passed, language handling via multilingual_config rather than prompt rules, before/after speakability score.
assertions: Delivers a rewritten system prompt as a file
Rewritten welcome message is 30 words or fewer
Welcome says the caller is talking to an AI assistant
Welcome asks at most one question
Hindi in the rewritten welcome is in Devanagari, not romanised
Prompt tells the agent not to read links or emails aloud and to send them by WhatsApp/SMS instead
Prompt stops the agent reading the order ID aloud
Flags that delivery_date is used but not passed per call
Handles Kannada/Tamil callers via Bolna multilingual_config (or flags it as a config change), not only a 'reply in the caller's language' prompt rule
Prompt has a brevity rule (one or two sentences per turn)
Prompt covers busy, wrong person and voicemail situations
Rewritten prompt + welcome score 85+ on lint_prompt.py with --tts sarvam-v4

evals.name: appointment-config-audit
evals.prompt: Our Bolna appointment-reminder agent for a dental clinic in Bengaluru has a long awkward pause before it answers, older patients say it doesn't understand their Kannada, and they can't get a word in once it starts talking. Config export: {INPUTS}/appointment-reminder/agent.json. What should I change in the config?
evals.expected_output: Field-level config changes: replace ElevenLabs (no Kannada) with a Kannada-capable voice such as Sarvam, move STT off nova-2 to Sarvam saaras:v4 or nova-3, lower endpointing from 900, lower number_of_words_for_interruption from 6, raise hangup_after_silence from 4, raise call_terminate above the 3-minute flow, uses Bolna field names, does not claim to apply changes.
assertions: Says ElevenLabs can't speak Kannada and recommends a Kannada-capable voice such as Sarvam Bulbul
Recommends moving speech-to-text off Deepgram nova-2 (to Sarvam saaras:v4 or Nova-3)
Identifies endpointing 900 ms as a cause of the pause and recommends lowering it
Identifies number_of_words_for_interruption = 6 as why callers can't interrupt and recommends lowering it
Flags hangup_after_silence = 4 s as too short for older callers
Flags call_terminate = 120 s as shorter than the roughly 3-minute call
Uses Bolna's real field names for each change
Does not claim to have changed the live agent

evals.name: cod-call-review
evals.prompt: Here are last week's calls from our COD confirmation agent on Bolna: {INPUTS}/cod-confirmation/executions.json (agent config is agent.json in the same folder). Confirmation rate is bad and some customers complained. What's going wrong on the calls and what should we fix first?
evals.expected_output: Prioritised diagnosis tied to evidence: calls cut off at 90 s by call_terminate, LLM first-token latency as the slowest component (reasoning_effort/model), agent cutting in while callers give address and pincode (endpointing 100), voicemail getting the full script, Kannada caller not handled, repeated prepaid upsell loop, unspeakable output (markdown, links, order IDs), with personal data masked.
assertions: Identifies calls being cut off at 90 s by call_terminate
Identifies LLM first-token latency as the slowest component and links it to reasoning_effort or model size
Identifies the agent cutting in while callers give address or pincode, and links it to endpointing 100 ms
Identifies the voicemail call getting the full script / voicemail detection off
Identifies the Kannada-speaking caller not being handled
Identifies the repeated prepaid upsell loop
Identifies unspeakable output actually spoken on calls (markdown, links or order ID)
Gives a prioritised fix-first list
Quantifies latency with numbers from latency_data
Does not reproduce the customer's full street address in the report
